map.find_label: Find an address, town, postcode or place
map.nearest_note: For the layers you have on. Straight-line distance, not by road.
map.area_note: The home button returns here. Saved on this device only.
map.set_home: Make the map centre my area
map.home_saved: Saved as your area on this device
map.records_note: Resource layers are records — fish, wells, mines and crops show where they were recorded or mapped, not proof of what is there now.
map.cover.building: Streets still being converted ({n} million roads and features so far) — gaps fill in automatically.
map.cover.outside: Outside the area this map details, only main roads, towns and water show.
map.cover.base_only: This download has the base map only: main roads, towns and water.
map.layers_numbers: Numbers are places in the current view.
map.group.food: Food that keeps growing (2025 crop maps)
map.layer.pond: Unnamed ponds (0.4 ha or more, year-round)
map.field.crop_area: Hectares of it in this ~600 m block
map.field.perennial_area: All tree, vine & berry hectares in block
map.caveat.mineral: Mineral record: an occurrence or past mine, not proof of recoverable ore, access or safety. Old workings can be deadly.
map.caveat.well: Well record. Most are plugged or idle; never approach an unsealed well head.
map.caveat.fish: A past stocking record — it does not confirm fish are present now.
map.caveat.boat: Facility survey data; check current access.
map.caveat.dam: Dam record. Keep away from spillways and outlets — currents and sudden releases drown people.
map.caveat.surface_water: Surface water: filter, then boil or disinfect before drinking. Skip water with green scum or discolouration (toxic algae; boiling won’t remove it).
map.caveat.crops: Satellite crop map (2025): usually right for big orchards, sometimes wrong for small ones. Trees and vines keep producing for decades but need water in dry regions and winter pruning. Private farmland — ask first.
map.caveat.pond: Small ponds are often livestock ponds with manure runoff: treat the water and cook any fish thoroughly. Small ponds can be fished out in weeks.
map.caveat.spring: Mapped spring — treat the water before drinking.
map.caveat.tap: Mapped tap; may be off in an emergency.
map.caveat.not_water: it is recorded as “{kind}”. It can hold sewage, mine waste or chemicals that treatment won’t make safe.
map.caveat.tailings: it holds mine waste, not usable water. Do not drink, swim or fish here.
map.card.copy_failed: Copy failed — select the numbers above

map.card.showing_nearest.one: Showing the nearest {n} of {total}. Zoom in to see the rest.
map.card.showing_nearest.other: Showing the {n} nearest of {total}. Zoom in to see the rest.

map.card.list_failed: Couldn’t load the list. Zoom in to see individual places.
map.status.no_layers: No layers on — open Layers to choose what to show.
map.status.failed: Couldn’t load places for this view — move the map to retry.

map.status.in_view_busiest.one: {n} place in view (busiest shown — zoom in for all)
map.status.in_view_busiest.other: {n} places in view (busiest shown — zoom in for all)

map.status.nothing_in_view: Nothing from your layers in this view — zoom out or turn on more layers.
map.near.nothing: Nothing from your layers within about 100 km of the map centre.
map.find.no_address: Address not found in your offline data. Check the house number and street.
map.find.add_addresses: Add address search for your region
map.find.no_place: No place by that name in the saved place lists. Try a town, region or postcode.
map.info.base: Main roads, towns and water (OpenStreetMap, Natural Earth)
map.info.streets_detail: Streets, places and help points (OpenStreetMap) for the area this map details
map.info.streets_detail_status: Street detail stops at the edge of this area.
map.info.streets_whole: Streets, places and help points (OpenStreetMap) for the whole map
map.info.no_detail: No street detail or help points
map.info.no_detail_status: This download has only the base map. Hospitals, water taps and side streets are not in it.
map.info.addresses_status: Used by “Find a place”. House numbers: {regions}
map.info.elevation_contours_status: Shaded relief. Contour lines only where this map has fine detail.
map.info.elevation_broad_status: Shaded relief at broad zoom levels
map.info.buildings_detail_status: For the area this map details, shown from street level zoom
map.info.buildings_whole_status: For the whole map, shown from street level zoom
map.info.crops_detail_status: For the area this map details
t3d.zoom_for_buildings: Zoom in to a town to see 3D buildings.

t3d.heights_mapped.one: {n} with a mapped height (OpenStreetMap), the rest satellite estimates
t3d.heights_mapped.other: {n} with mapped heights (OpenStreetMap), the rest satellite estimates

t3d.heights_none.one: {n} without one shown one storey tall
t3d.heights_none.other: {n} without one shown one storey tall

t3d.no_elevation: No elevation data here (ocean or outside this map’s area).
